title: Thiruvananthapuram doctor loses Rs 1.29 crore to phone scammers posing as officials; Rs 29 lakh recovered, Mathrubhumi reports
date_note: Mathrubhumi's publication day; the article says the first call came on November 6 and gives no earlier disclosure day.
org: Doctor at a private hospital, Thiruvananthapuram
geo_basis: victim's city stated in the article
summary: Mathrubhumi reports that a doctor in Thiruvananthapuram was cheated of Rs 1.29 crore by callers who posed as officials and said a SIM in his name was linked to a case over abusive calls to women. It says police recovered Rs 29 lakh. The City Cyber Crime Police Station is investigating, the article says.
plain: Mathrubhumi reports that a doctor in Thiruvananthapuram lost Rs 1.29 crore to callers posing as officials. Police recovered Rs 29 lakh, it says.
exec: Mathrubhumi reports a doctor lost Rs 1.29 crore to callers posing as officials, with Rs 29 lakh recovered.
